safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the wife was also vomiting slightly reduces clarity about possible household transmission and outbreak context, but it is unlikely to change immediate management for an otherwise uncomplicated acute gastroenteritis presentation. The main treatment plan (hydration, monitoring, return precautions) would typically remain the same.
